0022600191.text: The New York Knicks (4-4, 7th in the East, 3 games back in the Atlantic) are on the road at 1-2 and have won their last two, while the Cleveland Cavaliers (5-4, 6th in the East, 1.5 games back in the Central) are 4-1 at home and have won their last game. Josh Hart is out for New York with an ankle injury, and Cleveland is without Jarrett Allen (knee), Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain), and Sam Merrill (elbow). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, most recently winning 130-93 in Cleveland on May 25, 2026.
